Repo.name: Repo-lyzer
Repo.description: Repo-lyzer is a developer-focused CLI tool built in Go language that analyzes and compares GitHub repositories to help understand code structure, quality, and changes efficiently. It provides insights like file tree analysis, repository comparison, and actionable metrics, making it easier for developers and recruiters to evaluate projects quickly.
